description: feat/permanent-wounds: a DM imposes Lame AND Peg Leg — two wounds on the same part of the body (both 'leg' in DATA.wounds). One SOFT warning names the pair ('Lame and Peg Leg both injure the same place (leg) — a DM normally imposes only one'); it is advisory, not a ⛔ block, because the DM decides. Order follows the drawbacks list. No AP effect (both imposed). Pins the one-wound-per-place rule that EV-027's four different places deliberately avoid.
